## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
examples/demo/conftest.py — Point pytest at the demo settings so the django-pytest plugin configures Django.
examples/demo/demo_project/__init__.py
examples/demo/demo_project/settings.py — Minimal Django settings for the django-pytest demo project.
examples/demo/demo_project/urls.py — URL configuration for the demo project (empty — this demo is test-focused).
examples/demo/manage.py
examples/demo/shop/__init__.py
examples/demo/shop/apps.py — AppConfig for the demo shop app.
examples/demo/shop/pricing.py — Tiny pricing helpers — one is tested, one is not (to create a coverage gap).
examples/demo/shop/tests_pricing.py — Demo test suite with deliberate anti-patterns for `testcheck` to flag.
scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/quality_gate.py
src/django_pytest/__init__.py — Native pytest integration for Django plus a test analysis & optimization engine.
src/django_pytest/admin.py — Optional Django admin integration.
src/django_pytest/analysis/__init__.py — Test analysis & optimization engine.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/__init__.py — Check registry.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/anti_patterns.py — Static (AST) detection of common test anti-patterns.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/base.py — Base class and shared AST helpers for checks.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/coverage_gaps.py — Reports prioritized coverage gaps from a coverage.xml report.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/parallelization.py — Suggests parallelization strategy based on runtime totals.
src/django_pytest/analysis/checks/slow_tests.py — Flags slow tests using runtime durations captured by the plugin.
src/django_pytest/analysis/context.py — Builds the analysis context: parsed test files, runtime data and coverage.
src/django_pytest/analysis/engine.py — Orchestrates checks into a single report.
src/django_pytest/analysis/models.py — Core data structures shared across the analysis engine.
src/django_pytest/analysis/runtime.py — Runtime data captured by the pytest plugin and persisted between runs.
src/django_pytest/apps.py — Django application configuration.
src/django_pytest/management/__init__.py
src/django_pytest/management/commands/__init__.py
src/django_pytest/management/commands/pytest.py — `manage.py pytest` — run pytest with Django already wired up.
src/django_pytest/management/commands/testcheck.py — `manage.py testcheck` — analyze the test suite and report optimizations.
src/django_pytest/plugin.py — pytest plugin: native Django setup + runtime data collection.
src/django_pytest/reporters/__init__.py — Report renderers.
src/django_pytest/reporters/html_reporter.py — Standalone HTML reporter (self-contained, inline CSS — no assets needed).
src/django_pytest/reporters/json_reporter.py — Machine-readable JSON reporter.
src/django_pytest/reporters/terminal.py — Human-readable terminal reporter (ANSI colors when attached to a TTY).
src/django_pytest/runner.py — A configurable Django ``TEST_RUNNER`` that delegates to pytest.
tests/__init__.py
tests/conftest.py — Configures a minimal Django environment for the integration tests.
tests/tests_anti_patterns.py — AST-based anti-pattern detection.
tests/tests_checks_runtime.py — Slow-test, parallelization and coverage-gap checks.
